name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - North Las Vegas NV

fieldNotes.location: Roster had no address/coords. Resolved via web research: DHL Supply Chain's North Las Vegas project is a two-building, ~800,000 sq ft logistics complex in the Wesley D. Adams Innovation Park, Apex Industrial Park, City of North Las Vegas, on a ~50-acre tract (~$180M investment, 494+ jobs). No street address has been published. Satellite imagery (Maxar/Vexcel) at ~36.3454,-114.9345 shows a matching two-building complex - structurally complete; June 2024 user-contributed interior photos confirm finished empty warehouse shells. Construction completion was projected late 2025/2026.
fieldNotes.buildingSpecs: Per the project structural engineer (Wright Engineers): Building 1 = 450,241 SF, 40-ft clear, 84 overhead (dock) doors, 4 drive-in doors, 112 trailer stalls. Building 2 = 343,373 SF, 36-ft clear, 43 overhead doors, 2 drive-in doors, 62 trailer stalls. Totals: 127 dock doors, 174 trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: true - two distinct large distribution buildings on one campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 84 + 43 = 127 doors per engineer's published spec - band 50+. Satellite confirms long canopied dock banks on multiple building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 112 + 62 = 174 marked trailer stalls per spec - band 50+. Dedicated drop yards alongside the buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Building 1 has dock canopies on both its north and south faces (cross-dock layout) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE / INFERRED. No road-level Street View exists for this remote desert site and no exterior gate structure is clearly resolvable in satellite imagery. A new contract-logistics DC campus of this scale is near-certain to have a controlled, fenced truck entrance; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: false / uncertain - no guard booth resolvable in imagery; the site appears newly commissioned. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: true / inferred - assuming a truck gate with no guard booth (modern kiosk/app check-in). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: true / inferred - the site sits in remote desert terrain in far-north Apex, well away from dense development; cellular coverage may be weak. Medium confidence at best.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Apex Industrial Park is an isolated desert development ~20 miles NE of the Las Vegas Strip, surrounded by open desert and graded pads - Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: GOED announcement cited a ~50-acre tract; the developed two-building footprint measured from the perimeter box is ~55-65 acres. Reported ~58 as an honest estimate; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: 0 - imagery shows the buildings complete but the yard empty (pre-occupancy / commissioning phase).
